thesis.stat_label: of Aave v3 liquidations, last 12 months, hit positions under $10,000
thesis.headline: What forced liquidation costs small borrowers
thesis.body: 53,927 liquidation transactions totaling $1.65B, across every chain Dune indexes for Aave v3, deduped to the transaction level with bot dust excluded. By dollar volume the picture inverts (84.6% of value comes from 1,510 whale liquidations) but the typical liquidation event, by far, hits someone small. Original research, not a borrowed claim.

build.headline: merchant_withdraw_reconciled shipped 2026-09-14
build.body: Collapsed the two-transaction Kamino crank-then-withdraw flow into one. Modular Anchor v2 program: BNPL agreement lifecycle, escrow, merchant withdraw, cancellation and default paths, staking and yield accounting, emergency pause, per-agreement deposit caps.

position.headline: Everyday BNPL is the product. IBG is the proof.
position.body: Reconciled 2026-09-19: the protocol's identity is intuitive everyday BNPL on crypto rails. The IBG Optic Relic purchase, three installments, escrow earning yield, provenance transferring on completion, is the flagship demo of that product, not the other way around.
